name: MistCoin
title: The Spirit of the Prototype
tagline: MistCoin lingers as the ghost that inspired the ERC-20 standard during the Frontier Thawing.

chapters.heading: The first mist
paragraphs: A single candle flickers near a digital grave. On November 3, 2015, MistCoin arrived during the Frontier Thawing. It was a small program that lives on Ethereum. Fabian Vogelsteller brought it into the world from a specific wallet.

The contract was written in Solidity 0.1.6. On the day it was born, it was written into a block, one page of Ethereum's shared record book. It stood as a prototype for the ERC-20 standard. It is now about 11 years old.

chapters.heading: The prototype in the mist
paragraphs: Fabian Vogelsteller placed MistCoin on the chain on November 3, 2015. It lived as a test token while he shaped the idea of ERC-20. It held only transfer and balanceOf. It lacked transferFrom, approve, allowance, and totalSupply.

The contract sat in the quiet for sixteen days. On November 19, 2015, Fabian submitted the ERC-20 draft to the ethereum/EIPs repo. MistCoin was the prototype that inspired the standard even though it was not compliant. It has been active every year since 2024.
People called it to the transfer function 183 times.

chapters.heading: The knocking
paragraphs: MistCoin sits in the dark. Its code remains on the chain like a lingering breath. It holds about 0.00001 ETH deep inside.
The busy days are over. Only one call came in the last 12 months. Someone reached out to move funds between accounts. They still knock, seeking to move what remains.
